verified_facts.statement: The live installer authority was operationally insufficient for .github/workflows/**: the repository-scoped GITHUB_TOKEN job did not have GitHub App Workflows repository permission, so the P0A contract was internally coherent but not live-implementable with that credential boundary.

The controlled RED request i10-0089-contract-red-v1 produced exact head c8a016fc8472d784339a017c4838cd72b0f2dce5 and Infrastructure CI 33118606238 failed as expected because ADR 0010, INFRA_SPEC §39, and contracts/graphify-acceptance-runtime.v1.json did not yet exist.

The first GREEN publication produced dd00853dc1824b729adb1c91cc32e2ad36c351ba and CI 33124683312; that run exposed one accidental pre-§39 INFRA_SPEC word insertion and one genuine legacy #86 full-file identity assertion incompatible with the owner-approved append-only §39 successor. The #89 RED test itself was not changed.

Controlled fix request i10-0089-contract-green-fix-v1 restored the exact 77477-byte predecessor identity and changed only the legacy #86 test so its historical §38 identity is checked over that exact prefix. It produced source GREEN head dc26421a7b5ccd4f97ae0f7bda433ed78daaa2e4; Infrastructure CI 33125162225 ran on exactly that SHA and succeeded.

The exact runtime contract authorizes actions/python-versions release 3.12.10-14343898437, artifact python-3.12.10-linux-24.04-x64.tar.gz, size 121612690 bytes, SHA-256 b9bd943c5fc9244f796deef42c59d29ab9278d8a718851c67de6b44846320f33, executable report CPython 3.12.10, anonymous exact-URL acquisition and verified bounded task-local setup before the 900-second semantic builder timer.

decisions.decision: Treat #87 as superseded/not-planned, never completed, and keep the installed implementation dormant historical/fail-closed rather than repair it.
decisions.rationale: Live acceptance is authoritative and disproved the protected-path authority assumed by the installed route.

decisions.decision: Defer credentialed protected-path mutation to I11 and authorize no PAT, GitHub App credential/private key, deploy key, connector credential, or other substitute long-lived privilege in I10-0089.
decisions.rationale: Future protected-path authority requires a separate security/architecture decision covering exact Workflows permission, repository scope, storage, rotation, revocation, duration/review date, audit and cleanup.

decisions.decision: Make exact in-job CPython 3.12.10 acquisition inside ordinary read-only CI the mandatory future #85 route; #85 depends on completed #89 rather than completed #87 and must avoid .github/**.
decisions.rationale: This is the least-authority implementation route consistent with the live failure evidence.

decisions.decision: Keep #73 paused until completed #85 and require any resumed execution to use a fresh replacement hwm-lab branch from then-current hwm-lab/main, leaving both historical #73 recovery anchors immutable.
decisions.rationale: The failed historical runtime path must not be resumed or mutated in place.

rejected_alternatives.reason: The active route is superseded and credentialed protected-path authority is explicitly deferred to I11.
The exception is historical, one-time and must never be reused after this reconciliation.
